tutanota.description:
Tuta Mail is a free, open-source email application designed to protect your privacy with built-in end-to-end encryption and an ad-free experience.

Secure your email communications with quantum-resistant encryption, encrypted mailbox storage, and protection against tracking. Tuta Mail allows you to exchange encrypted messages with other Tuta users and send password-protected confidential emails to people using other email providers.

Manage your inbox with customizable folders, labels, secure full-text search, swipe gestures, and notifications. Access previously synchronized emails offline, organize your contacts, and keep your mailbox synchronized across Android, iOS, desktop, and the web.

The app offers light and dark themes, two-factor authentication, and privacy-focused operation without relying on Google push notifications. A free email account is available, with optional paid plans for additional storage, custom domains, and advanced organization features.

Developed by Tutao GmbH in Germany, Tuta Mail's client source code is available under the GPL-3.0 license. A Tuta account is required, and traditional IMAP, POP3, and SMTP client access is not supported.
